claims.statement: .claude/ in a full-install consumer is a self-contained Git repository on the branch ai-state tracking both installed bootstrap files and mutable AI state, and the outer repository ignores it entirely so its commits are visible only through git -C .claude.

state-sync.sh is pure Bash rendered into both .claude/hooks/scripts/ and .devcontainer/ so a fresh clone can bootstrap .claude before it exists; it resolves the repository root from its own location or AI_STATE_REPO_ROOT and honors --local-only or AI_STATE_LOCAL_ONLY=1 to skip all remote interaction.

Every mutating state-sync.sh command is dispatched with a trailing warn-and-continue and the script always exits 0, so a missing remote, offline network, or rebase conflict can never block a session or fail an outer commit; warnings go to stderr and hooks-errors.log.

checkpoint initializes the nested repository if needed (restoring root adapters on that path) and commits local AI state with no remote operation; push is checkpoint followed by publish and skips publication when the checkpoint fails.

pull records local nested state first, reconciles committed state with origin/ai-state when a remote is configured and not in local-only mode, and only after a successful reconcile restores root adapters and checkpoints.
publish sends only already committed state: a dirty nested worktree makes it warn and preserve the uncheckpointed state, a clean one reconciles then pushes, and repeated clean publication is a no-op.

reconcile_committed_state returns immediately in local-only mode or without a configured remote, otherwise re-pins the origin refspecs to the ai-state branch before any fetch and treats a refspec failure as a reason to skip remote reconciliation while keeping local commits.

Mutating commands run through dispatch_mutating, which takes the sync lock and then runs preflight_unfinished_operation: an unfinished merge, or a rebase other than the exact orphaned autostash leftover, is found by file, left untouched with one logged warning advising --continue or --abort, and returned as a protected-operation status that the dispatcher turns into exit 0, while the orphaned autostash leftover alone is cleared with rebase --quit.

The nested repository's .gitignore excludes .cache/, session_logs/hooks-errors.log, and settings.local.json, and untrack_local_only_paths removes all three from the index without deleting them whenever commit_local_state runs, while session_logs/hooks-bypass.log stays tracked; a .gitattributes gives session_logs/*.log the merge=union driver.

restore-root-adapters.sh copies the installer-owned root adapters carried in .claude/bootstrap-root/ back to their real locations outside .claude/, reading the list from .claude/bootstrap-ownership.env, and exits 0 silently when either the mirror or the manifest is absent.

configure_outer_hooks_path sets the outer repository's core.hooksPath to the fixed literal .claude/hooks/git-hooks once that directory exists, leaves a matching value alone, overwrites a different value with a warning naming the old one, and only warns on failure; it is the one write state-sync.sh makes outside .claude/.

The outer post-commit Git hook runs record-commit-closeout.sh to advance a completed phase and then state-sync.sh push with stdin from /dev/null; Git ignores its exit status so it can never fail the commit.

Bootstrap refreshes land as bootstrap:-prefixed nested commits made by the installer's sync step, distinct from the session: commits session hooks make, so the nested log separates the two sources of change.

The installer dispatches --backup-state to _run_backup_state (and so to backup_sidecar_state), --uninstall to _run_uninstall (and so to uninstall_sidecar), and a sidecar target to install_sidecar before validate_agents_takeover or any other full-install step, so a sidecar install, uninstall, or state backup creates or touches no nested .claude repository, ai-state branch, or state sync; a missing git executable ends the install and uninstall paths with 'git not found on PATH' instead of a traceback.

state-sync keeps a byte copy of settings.local.json around every pull and unrelated-history merge and afterwards restores it only when the file is missing or equals the origin/<branch> version git wrote; any other content is kept as a newer write together with the copy and a warning, and a failure to make the copy skips the pull or merge.

write_nested_gitignore and write_nested_gitattributes write their template only when the file is missing and otherwise append only absent lines, adding the settings.local.json line only when git check-ignore --no-index exits exactly 1; they run on setup of an existing nested repository and on every checkpoint, so a consumer's own lines survive and an older repository gains the union-merge rule.

commit_local_state refuses before any staging while a rebase or merge is unfinished in the nested repository or git ls-files -u lists unmerged paths, so no state-sync commit can conclude an operation or record conflict markers.

When the current pull's rebase --abort fails, or an unrelated-history merge that created MERGE_HEAD cannot be aborted, state sync leaves the operation in place, keeps and names the settings.local.json copy instead of restoring it, and setup returns before restoring root adapters or committing.

Before the unrelated-history merge or the pull rebase, reconcile_committed_state records whether HEAD and origin/<branch> share history, re-checks for an unfinished operation, and commits local changes, so an abort never has uncommitted local work to lose.

acquire_sync_lock takes an exclusive flock on the repository root folder through descriptor 9 with no lock file; a busy run prints a stderr notice and skips, setup and migrate-from-hf wait up to 60 seconds and then log a warning and skip, and a missing or failing flock leaves sync running unlocked.
status reports rebase, merge, and lock state; sync_lock_state probes the lock on descriptor 8 with flock -n and closes it at once, so status never waits for or keeps the lock.

state-sync.sh exports GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 and defaults GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT to 1000 and GIT_HTTP_LOW_SPEED_TIME to 60 while keeping caller-set values, so a stalled HTTPS transfer is cancelled and Git never waits for a typed password, without changing any Git command line; an HTTPS connection still being opened and SSH remotes have no stall limit.

An EXIT trap, reached through INT, TERM, and HUP traps that call exit, hands a held settings.local.json copy to restore_local_settings after an early stop, or keeps and names the copy while a rebase or merge is unfinished.

restore-root-adapters.sh refuses a symlinked .claude or .claude/bootstrap-root with exit 1 before resolving any path, after its silent exit 0 for a missing mirror or manifest, so it never copies adapter files from outside the repository.

The generated devcontainer.json runs a list-form initializeCommand that creates ${localEnv:HOME}/.openwiki and ${localEnv:HOME}/.cache/huggingface on the host before its bind mounts are created, and validate_targets.py requires that exact command.

validate_targets.py requires the generated state-sync.sh to invoke git rebase --quit exactly once, for the orphaned autostash auto-clear, and never to silence a failed rebase or merge abort with || true.

Both Claude Code and Codex run state-sync.sh push on UserPromptSubmit; Codex runs a local state-sync.sh checkpoint on SessionEnd, while Claude Code runs state-sync.sh push on SessionEnd and state-sync.sh checkpoint on StopFailure.

Claude Code, Codex, and GitHub Copilot run state-sync.sh pull at SessionStart, while Antigravity wires only a PreToolUse bridge and no lifecycle hooks; GitHub Copilot's Stop runs state-sync.sh push instead of a Stop wrapper.
